;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Kyrgyzstan]]'s [[State Committee for National Security (Kyrgyzstan)|security forces]] storm the compound of former [[President of Kyrgyzstan|President]] [[Almazbek Atambayev]] on the outskirts of [[Bishkek]] for the second time after a failed overnight raid left one officer dead. Atambayev and his loyalists are "putting up severe armed resistance", according to President [[Sooronbay Jeenbekov]]. Atambayev is detained, ending a two-day standoff. One officer was killed, while 80 people were injured. [https://reuters.com/article/uk-kyrgyzstan-atambayev/ex-president-of-kyrgyzstan-detained-a-day-after-violent-botched-raid-idUKKCN1UY0PC?il=0 (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-49273236 (BBC News)]
*[[War in Catatumbo]]
**The Human Rights Watch breaks a report on violence around the [[Colombia]]—[[Venezuela]] border since the [[Colombian peace process]], announcing that there has been an ongoing War in the {{ill|Catatumbo region|es|Región del Catatumbo}} since early 2018. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/08/colombia-border-venezuela-war-farc-report (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.hrw.org/report/2019/08/08/war-catatumbo/abuses-armed-groups-against-civilians-including-venezuelan-exiles (Human Rights Watch)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Floods hit the states of [[Karnataka]] and [[Kerala]] in [[India]], resulting in 11 dead and 43,000 people being evacuated. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/india/11-dead-43000-people-evacuated-as-flood-rains-hit-indian-states-of-karnataka-kerala-1.1565250624965 (''Gulf News'')]

;Health and environment
*[[Dengue fever outbreaks]]
**The Department of Health of the [[Philippines]] declares a national [[dengue]] epidemic in the country, as cases spike to 622 deaths. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/philippines/622-dengue-deaths-philippines-declares-national-epidemic-1.1565092318918 (''Gulf News'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Uruapan massacre]]
**[[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]] massacres 19 people, hanging 9 of their desecrated bodies from a bridge in [[Uruapan]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/aug/08/mexico-bodies-police-uruapan-drug-cartels (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Matteo Salvini]], [[Deputy Prime Minister of Italy|Italian Deputy Prime Minister]], announces the collapse of the [[2018 Italian government formation|coalition government]] with the [[Five Stars Movement]], opening the possibility of holding a snap election. [https://www.politico.eu/article/matteo-salvini-italian-government-on-verge-of-collapse/ (Politico)]
*[[Marek Kuchciński]], speaker of the [[Sejm]] in [[Poland]], announces his resignation after admitting the use of a government jet for 23 personal flights. [https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/news/polands-parliament-speaker-resigns-over-private-flights-scandal/ (Euractiv)]
